name: flow-control
description: Stay in flow while the project keeps its structure. Capture intercepts ideas, requests and bugs you mention mid-thread, then triages them into the current or next sprint, the backlog or ideas, with a category and a priority, and goes back to the task in hand. Also sets up an in-repo planning scaffold, plans sprints, gates releases until the sprint is done, and answers "what's next". Works for code and non-code projects.
